entries.speaker: Overbearing Detective
entries.en: Take a seat.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: We're sorry to take your time. This will be[n]over quick.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Let's see... [f 4 3].

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Ah yes, you're the one currently under[n]probation.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: It says here you had a dispute with[n]Mr. Kamoshida?
Yeah, that happened.
Nope.
What if I did?

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: You're more hot-blooded than you look.

entries.speaker: Overbearing Detective
entries.en: We know if you're lying.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: I'm sure it must be something he would[n]rather not remember.

entries.speaker: Overbearing Detective
entries.en: What's with that tone of voice?

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: I'm sorry if I offended you.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: ...You spend time with quite an[n]interesting group. Yusuke Kitagawa[n]and Haru Okumura?

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: The more friends the better, right?

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: ...I'm sorry to have taken your time.[n]You're free to go now.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Oh, I almost forgot. There's just one[n]more thing I have to ask you.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Do you think the Phantom Thieves are[n]associated with this school?
Maybe.
Is that really true?
I hope not...

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Surprisingly, that's the response we get[n]from most people your age.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: We won't know for certain unless[n]we investigate further.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Don't worry. We're here to keep all of[n]you safe, okay?

entries.speaker: Overbearing Detective
entries.en: Thank you for your time.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Your responses will serve as great[n]reference material.

entries.speaker: Nice Detective
entries.en: Takamaki-san is next. Could you ask her[n]to come in?
